create_token_block_dataset: create a TokenBlockDataset to break a token dataset into fixed-size blocks for sequence modeling
build_eos_break_mode: build a TokenBlockDataset with eos break mode where each block contains one complete sentence
test_complete_break_mode: test the TokenBlockDataset with complete break mode to ensure blocks contain complete sentences
review_include_targets: review the TokenBlockDataset include_targets feature that returns source, target, and past_target tuples
summarize_prefetch: summarize the TokenBlockDataset prefetch method that preloads underlying dataset indices for blocks
